parts:
I got the following log (partial) of an error on trying to deploy an app that worked fine locally

It succesfully deployed after I ran the following lines to make all data.tables data.frames (only?),  but it feels like I shouldn't have to , in order to go from local to shinyapps.io
Thoughts?

li_dfs <- ls()[sapply(ls(),function(t) is.data.frame(get(t)))]
sapply(li_dfs, function(t) assign(t, as.data.frame(get(t)),envir = .GlobalEnv))
